items.title: Zelensky should be asked what he knew about government corruption, sacked minister tells BBC
items.description: Mykhailo Fedorov has also called for wartime elections to be held in Ukraine.

items.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
items.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

items.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30
items.description: A mound of rubbish at a major waste site buried several homes in the capital, the government says.

items.title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
items.description: Representatives met in Switzerland to work out next steps to resolve the conflict.

items.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
items.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.

items.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
items.description: No group has claimed responsibility for the attacks, which the military said "aimed at creating unrest".

items.title: Australian shark attack victim grateful for 'second chance at life'
items.description: Leah Stewart was mauled by a shark in June, suffering multiple bites to her arms and legs.
